rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The second transcription folds the qualifying-child, dependency and credit tests into each credit line and writes the complements with `not`; the project names them as helper lines and the per-person credit amounts read those helpers. Both read Steps 1 to 5 the same way: the age tests with the student and disabled branches and "younger than you", the relationship list, the support, joint-return and residency conditions, citizenship and TIN for the credits, and the filer's TIN or work SSN. The second transcription was made before BUG-0011 and BUG-0015 split the relationship values and before BUG-0012 split the head of household tests into `hoh_test1` and `hoh_test2` (the two lines it lacks); its `hoh_person` carries both tests in one line. The divorced-parent rule the second did not apply is refused by the project. No change to the data.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The second transcription folds the qualifying-child, dependency and credit tests into each credit line and writes the complements with `not`; the project names them as helper lines and the per-person credit amounts read those helpers. Both read Steps 1 to 5 the same way: the age tests with the student and disabled branches and "younger than you", the relationship list, the support, joint-return and residency conditions, citizenship and TIN for the credits, and the filer's TIN or work SSN. The second transcription was made before BUG-0011 and BUG-0015 split the relationship values and before BUG-0012 split the head of household tests into `hoh_test1` and `hoh_test2` (the two lines it lacks); its `hoh_person` carries both tests in one line. The divorced-parent rule the second did not apply is refused by the project. No change to the data.
